entities.name: Query uL1 protein
observations: 231 aa bacterial ribosomal protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q2RFN6 from Moorella thermoacetica.
Predicted molecular weight is 25,011.9 Da and theoretical pI is 9.69; calculated charge at pH 7 is +9.79.
Contains a Ribosomal_L1 domain (PF00687.27) spanning residues 30–220 with i-Evalue 4e-76.
Homolog annotations indicate binding to 23S rRNA and participation in the 50S ribosomal subunit.
The L1 stalk participates in E-site tRNA release; uL1 is also reported to autoregulate translation of the L11 operon through mRNA binding.
Associated GO terms: large ribosomal subunit, rRNA binding, structural constituent of ribosome, and translation.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
